description: Defines the rx::ImageD3D class, an abstract base class for renderer-specific surface/resource interfaces in Direct3D within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: ImageD3D
classes.description: Abstract base class for renderer-specific image surfaces and resources in Direct3D.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the image.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the image.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth of the image.

methods.name: getInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns the internal format of the image.

methods.name: isRenderableFormat
methods.description: Checks if the format is renderable.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if the image is dirty (abstract method).

methods.name: redefine
methods.description: Redefines the image with new type, format, size, and release option.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads data into the image from the provided context and area.

methods.name: loadCompressedData
methods.description: Loads compressed data into the image.

methods.name: setManagedSurfaceCube
methods.description: Sets a managed cube map surface.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies the image to a texture storage.
